cards.hint: Think about the size of starting material
cards.quote: Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) is a technique used to "amplify" small segments of DNA.
cards.stem: What does PCR amplify for further study

cards.hint: Think of an identification method using copied material
cards.quote: including DNA fingerprinting, detection of bacteria or viruses (particularly AIDS), and diagnosis of genetic disorders
cards.stem: Which procedure can use material produced by PCR

cards.hint: Consider the value of extra copies for labs
cards.quote: Once amplified, the DNA produced by PCR can be used in many different laboratory procedures.
cards.stem: What happens to DNA after it is amplified by PCR

cards.hint: Think about making maps of genetic material
cards.quote: For example, most mapping techniques in the Human Genome Project (HGP) relied on PCR.
cards.stem: What type of project work relied on PCR
